Thirty students and three teachers go by bus on a school trip to the zoo.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
The entrance fee is $10 for each student and $15 for each teacher.
Find the total cost of the entrance fees.
Answer(a) $  ............................................................. [2]

content.html: The entrance fee is $10 for each student and $15 for each teacher. Find the total cost of the entrance fees.
content.text: The entrance fee is $10 for each student and $15 for each teacher. Find the total cost of the entrance fees.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
The bus costs $600 to hire.
Lunch costs $5 for each person.
Find the total cost of the trip including the entrance fees.
Answer(b) $  ............................................................. [2]

content.html: The bus costs $600 to hire. Lunch costs $5 for each person. Find the total cost of the trip including the entrance fees.
content.text: The bus costs $600 to hire. Lunch costs $5 for each person. Find the total cost of the trip including the entrance fees.

parts.label: c
parts.text:
The total cost of the trip is divided between the 30 students.
Calculate the cost of the trip for each student.
Answer(c) $  ............................................................. [2]

content.html: The total cost of the trip is divided between the 30 students. Calculate the cost of the trip for each student.
